releases.new: Run SQL against nested schemas, including creating, dropping, inserting into and querying tables within them.
releases.breaking: Integer division by zero now raises an error instead of returning NULL; guard divisors or handle the error in queries that relied on NULL.

releases.new: Add an enable_optimistic_write setting to control optimistic writes.
releases.breaking: Identifiers in error messages are now always quoted, so code or scripts matching error message text may need updating.

releases.new: Support the duckdb:// URI scheme in the ADBC driver's URI option.
Use the new experimental vacuum_rebuild_indexes option when attaching a database.
